authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 12370 śāka potherb, vegetable gives Prakrit sāga/sāya and Pali sāka. The survey sag/sāg vegetable responses retain the voiced stop of the sāga branch; the isolated sãg nasalisation is preserved as a regional qualification. This is a comparative vegetable-family link, with local Indo-Aryan transmission unresolved. Exact response: sāg.
